cover: Before you connect two business tools

slides.title: Does each tool support it?
slides.body: Is there a documented API? Does it send webhooks for the events you care about, such as a payment or a new order?

slides.title: Which system owns each field?
slides.body: If an address changes in the CRM and in accounting on the same day, one has to win. Write down which.

slides.title: Do the words mean the same?
slides.body: "Client", "account" and "customer" might be one thing in three tools, or they might not. Map each field.

slides.title: What if one side is down?
slides.body: Retry, queue, alert someone, or a mix. Decide what happens when a call fails for an hour.

slides.title: Is the receiver built for webhooks?
slides.body: Messages verified, duplicates caught by event ID, no reliance on order, a quick reply with the work done from a queue.

slides.title: Who hears when it breaks?
slides.body: Name who gets the alert. Without a daily check that totals match, a failure can sit unnoticed until month end.
